'''2008 Northern Colorado Mini-Open''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG mini-open announced for 27 September 2008 at 11 am at Gryphon Cards and Comics, 2020 S. College, Fort Collins, Colorado, with [[Thomas McGee|Tom McGee]] as tournament director under the three-judge system.<ref name="pcf-22819-330914">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330914#330914 Northern Colorado Mini-Open], AnakinSolo, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083837/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330930 Internet Archive]</ref> The announcement said it "may be the last bye opportunity before the worlds weekend" for the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-22819-330914" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Gryphon Cards and Comics, 2020 S. College, Fort Collins, Colorado<ref name="pcf-22819-330914" />
* '''Dates:''' 27 September 2008<ref name="pcf-22819-330914" />
* '''Time:''' 11 am<ref name="pcf-22819-330914" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, with all cards, virtual sets and errata legal; no decklists required<ref name="pcf-22819-330914" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10; prizes for all<ref name="pcf-22819-330914" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Thomas McGee|Tom McGee]], with the three-judge system<ref name="pcf-22819-330914" />

== Organization ==

On 26 August 2008 McGee asked the players who planned to come to choose between an upgraded prize package and cash prizes of "probably around a 100 to 150 bucks" depending on turnout.<ref name="pcf-22819-331228">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=331228#331228 Northern Colorado Mini-Open], Tom McGee (Beatstick), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083837/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330930 Internet Archive]</ref> On 6 September the player who had posted the announcement, posting as AnakinSolo, predicted a turnout of "somewhere around 8-10".<ref name="pcf-22819-334450">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334450#334450 Northern Colorado Mini-Open], AnakinSolo, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917023545/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334450 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

No results were posted in the forum topic as captured on 17 September 2008.
